FACT-CHECK UPDATE (2026-07-10 verification pass): tissue_preservation filled in as 'fresh_frozen', previously 'Not reported'. The series summary discusses FFPE only as background motivation (limitations of standard clinical FFPE workflows generally), which initially made the actual preservation method of these specific 29 samples ambiguous between the 'Traditional' and 'NICO' extraction protocols being compared. Resolved by checking individual GSM sample titles directly: both protocols use an 'FF' (fresh frozen) prefix in the sample title (e.g. 'NICO-FF07171890' and 'ST-FF07172307'), confirming all 29 samples across both protocols are fresh-frozen tissue, not FFPE.
